desc.zh: 擦掉“谁在忙”，按开始时间扫描并维护最远结束：从逐段检查到一次扫描。
desc.en: Drop who is busy, sweep by start time and keep the furthest end: from checking every piece to one sweep.

complexity: O(N log N) time for N intervals in total; O(N) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Free for everyone means outside the union
concepts.description: Employee labels can be erased; only the union of all busy intervals and its interior holes matter.

concepts.name: Furthest end (reach) sweep
concepts.description: Sorted by start, a gap exists exactly when the next start exceeds the furthest end seen so far.
